purpose: Strict GitHub evidence coverage inventory of recognizable case-study and application code groups; NOT a scientific execution or manuscript inspection certification.
limitations: Only repository directory paths inspected; assets in manuscript packages, release ZIPs, CI artifacts or other directories may exist but were not matched.
A committed image may be illustrative rather than an authentic experimental result; content must be inspected.
A code file or README is not proof that the code executed.
The registry covers recognizable experiment/code paths, not every manuscript application or case study.
No universal unit can be certified from this repository scan alone.
